films.title: A Talent for Murder
films.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.

films.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Starlight Express
films.synopsis:
Filmed live at the specially designed Starlight Auditorium at Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE will immerse audiences in a world of speed, song and storytelling as an incredible cast of 40 whizz across the screen, performing some of musical theatre’s most beloved songs.

As a child’s train set magically comes to life and the engines race to become the fastest in the world, Rusty the steam train has little hope of winning until he is inspired by the legend of the ‘Starlight Express’.

A show seen around the world by over 30 million people,and with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber and lyrics by Richard Stilgoe, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE is an electrifying experience for all ages.

films.title: CBeebies Panto 2026: Treasure Island
films.synopsis:
Ahoy there, mateys young and young at heart! There will be singing, dancing and laughs for everyone this festival season, when the CBeebies Panto returns for a new adventure.

This year, the CBeebies team has reimagined the pirate classic Treasure Island, with popular performers Andy Day, Jennie Dale, Justin Fletcher, Rhys Stephenson, Rebecca Keatley and George Webster making their way across the seven seas in search of buried treasure.

With music from Banks & Wag, and a special song showing only in cinemas, this Christmas special is sure to have everyone singing, dancing and a-harr’ing along.

films.title: Charity Screening - Inside Out
films.certNote: very mild threat
films.synopsis: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions -Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness -conflict on how best to navigate a new city, house, and school.

films.title: Clayface
films.certNote: strong bloody violence, injury detail
films.synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

films.title: Disney's Hexed
films.synopsis: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad and produced by Roy Conli.

films.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
films.synopsis: Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler. For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit have been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself. This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era – from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.

films.title: Ebenezer
films.certNote: Scenes of supernatural threat throughout and some disturbing images that may frighten younger children.
films.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The classic Christmas tale. Told like never before. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

films.title: Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience
films.synopsis:
Join Peppa Pig and her family at the cinema for a festive big-screen experience as they celebrate Evie’s first Christmas! Share in the excitement of Christmas Day as the family of five reflect on
treasured seasonal memories. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the tree, this hour-long cinema experience brings together 7 classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes and 4
brand-new songs that little ones can dance and sing along to. Filled with laughter, music and heartwarming moments, this special cinema experience is the perfect family day out during the
Christmas season. So grab your hats, scarves and gloves and enjoy the magic of the season along with your favourite piggies at the Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience!

films.title: Focker-in-Law
films.synopsis:
This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.

films.title: Forgotten Island
films.certNote: threat, violence, injury detail, language, dangerous behaviour, rude humour
films.synopsis:
Your best friendship is worth fighting for.

DreamWorks Animation, the studio that brought you unforgettable bonds between a boy and a dragon in How to Train Your Dragon, an ogre and a donkey in Shrek, and a robot and a gosling in The Wild Robot, now welcomes a dazzling and emotional story about two lifelong best friends who must come together before they drift apart in Forgotten Island.

The new original film is written and directed by Academy Award® nominee Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado and is produced by Academy Award® nominee Mark Swift, the filmmaking team behind Puss in Boots: The Last Wish.

Grammy and Academy Award® winning supernova H.E.R. and Liza Soberano (Lisa Frankenstein, Alone/Together) star as high school graduates Jo and Raissa, who have been best friends since grade school but are now about to embark on separate life paths.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families.

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

The film’s all-star voice cast also includes Emmy nominee Jenny Slate (Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Dying for Sex), Manny Jacinto (The Good Place, Top Gun: Maverick), BAFTA nominee Dolly de Leon (Triangle of Sadness, Ghostlight), global comedy superstar Jo Koy (Haunted Mansion, Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn) and Emmy winner Ronny Chieng (The Daily Show, M3GAN).

films.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
films.certNote: moderate sex references
films.synopsis: George Michael was one of the most influential stars of his generation; his voice and songwriting defined an era. Assembled from rediscovered, previously unseen and unheard 35mm footage of his 1988 performance at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, this new concert film captures George at the height of his creative power during the record-breaking Faith Tour. Expertly restored and remastered, the film transforms a defining cultural moment into a spectacular cinema experience. An original short film by Mary McCartney opens the feature, using newly discovered audio and imagery from 1986–1988 – the Faith era – creating a rare and intimate ‘time capsule’, offering a vivid insight into George’s mindset at this pivotal moment in his life.

films.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
films.certNote: mild scary scenes, rude humour, violence, language, drug references
films.synopsis: The beloved and award-winning BBC comedy GHOSTS arrives on the big screen this Halloween. GHOSTS' stars, writers and creators Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond are back, along with Lolly Adefope, Charlotte Ritchie and Kiell Smith-Bynoe, in a feature length family adventure.

films.title: GIANT – The Play
films.synopsis:
GIANT, the 5-star critically acclaimed play starring John Lithgow (Killers of the Flower Moon, The Crown) as Roald Dahl, comes to the big screen. Winner of 3 Olivier Awards® including Best Play and a Tony Award® for Best Actor in a Play (John Lithgow), the production was filmed live in London’s West End ahead of its sold-out Broadway run. The stellar cast includes Aya Cash (The Boys, The Franchise, You’re the Worst), Elliot Levey (Cold War, Patriots, Good) and Rachael Stirling (The Divine Mrs S).

A world-famous children’s author under threat. A battle of wills in the wake of scandal. And one chance to make amends...It’s the summer of 1983, The Witches is about to hit the shelves and Roald Dahl is making last-minute edits.  But the outcry at his recent, explicitly antisemitic article won’t die down. Across a single afternoon at his family home, and rocked by an unexpectedly explosive confrontation, Dahl is forced to choose: make a public apology or risk his name and reputation. Inspired by real events, GIANT explores with dark humour the difference between considered opinion and dangerous rhetoric offering a complicated portrait of a fiendishly charismatic icon.

films.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
films.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. 

Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. 

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. 

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

films.title: Hadestown: The Musical
films.certNote: mild violence, injury detail, threat, sex references
films.synopsis: The live theater capture of the hit musical Hadestown, which won eight Tony Awards in 2019 including Best Musical and the 2020 Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album, featuring the five original principals of the Broadway company. The genre-defying new musical blends modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale. Following two intertwining love stories — that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and that of King Hades and his wife Persephone —Hadestowninvites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.

films.title: Heart of the Beast
films.certNote: moderate injury detail, threat, violence, language
films.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

films.title: How to Rob a Bank
films.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs - and their most ambitious heist yet.

films.title: IFF Christmas Karma
films.certNote: mild violence, discrimination, language
films.synopsis:
From visionary British director Gurinder Chadha (Bend It Like Beckham, Blinded By The Light), CHRISTMAS KARMA sees ones of history’s greatest novels - Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol transformed into a joyous, colourful, feel-good Christmas musical that celebrates modern-day London and all of its communities and cultures.

Starring Kunal Nayyar, Eva Longoria, Billy Porter, Boy George, Danny Dyer, Leo Suter, Pixie Lott, Charithra Chandran and Hugh Bonneville. Featuring music from Gary Barlow, Nitin Sawhney, Shaznay Lewis, Ben Cullum, Panjabi MC, Jassi Sidhu and Malkit Singh the film features an eclectic soundtrack influenced by gospel, bhangra, carols, rap and classic pop songs. You will not be able to sit still!

Told from Chadha’s unique point of view and in her own distinctive style, the film resonates with Dickens’ masterful statement on the human condition, exploring themes of prejudice, acceptance, reconciliation, identity and belonging. Inspired by Frank Capra’s timeless ‘It’s A Wonderful Life’, CHRISTMAS KARMA is a festive British classic for our times, and for generations to come, that promotes a strong message to be kind, choose love and celebrate the present.

films.title: Jak zyc, zeby nie zwariowac
films.certNote: moderate sex, sex references, sexual violence references, strong language
films.synopsis: Anka seems to have it all: a husband, children, a career and a comfortable home. Then infidelity, job loss and financial trouble turn her life upside down. Faced with family tensions, an overprotective mother and unexpected new connections, she sets out to rebuild her life on her own terms. A comedy about imperfect people, complicated relationships and new beginnings.

films.title: Ken Russell's The Devils
films.certNote: strong sex, nudity, violence
films.synopsis:
Censored for more than half a century, Ken Russell’s visionary masterpiece returns to the big screen fully restored in 4K and cut to Russell’s direction - the first publicly released version of the film as intended by the filmmaker. Unveiled at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, the definitive version arrives 55 years after the film’s original release.
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption, and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, the film lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. 
In addition to powerhouse performances from Reed and Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils showcases the stunning work of artists at the peak of their craft: Academy Award-winning cinematographer David Watkin (Out of Africa, Chariots of Fire); editor Michael Bradsell (Local Hero, Jabberwocky); and visual artist Derek Jarman (Jubilee, Caravaggio), whose work as production designer marked his feature film debut.

films.title: Klara and the Sun
films.certNote: moderate threat, violence, injury detail, infrequent strong language
films.synopsis:
Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and 
they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light 
to Josie’s complicated world.

films.title: Manipulation
films.synopsis: An omnipresent threat of manipulation looms over the world. It can emerge anywhere, at any time, and by any means.

films.title: Mission Santa
films.synopsis: Santa’s Workshop has modernized — magic and tradition replaced by automation and efficiency. It even appears that Santa himself has retired, leaving North Pole operations in the capable hands of a new generation of process-loving, tech savvy elves. It’s something Yoyo, a lovable but naive, homeschooled elf, was not expecting on the first day of his dream job. But when a scroogey hacker bent on revenge takes control of the North Pole, Yoyo's shock at the spiritless state of the workshop is quickly replaced by another fear — Christmas will be destroyed if Santa isn’t handed over! Unfortunately, no one at the workshop has any idea where Santa is or how to find him! Almost no one that is. After Yoyo proclaims that his Grandpa will know how to find Santa… he teams up with a cynical HR elf, his loyal reindeer pup and a misfit packaging drone on a wild and heartwarming mission to save the day and help everyone re-discover the true magic of Christmas spirit.

films.title: National Theatre Live: Golden Boy
films.certNote: moderate bad language, injury detail, discrimination, threat
films.synopsis:
★★★★★ 
'Josh O'Connor is a knockout' 
Sunday Times 

Following a sold-out London run, Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ American classic.  

1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side.  

Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.   

★★★★★ 
Sunday Times, City AM, British Theatre Guide 

★★★★ 
Guardian, Time Out, Telegraph, Independent, Daily Mail, The Stage, WhatsOnStage

films.title: ODEON Pride Nights - A Wolf Among the Swans
films.synopsis: "A Wolf Among Swans" tells the story of Thiago Soares, a boy from the suburbs of Rio de Janeiro who leaves hip hop behind and embarks on the world of classical ballet. His story takes unexpected turns through his turbulent relationship with his mentor, the Cuban Dino Carrera, who hones Thiago's talent until he achieves stardom by becoming the principal dancer of the Royal Ballet in London.

films.title: Onwards and Sideways
films.synopsis:
Tony Evans is deputy head of a primary school. Emma Kent is a musician and composer, and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other. until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives. On the same morning, these two are simultaneously confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s Disease. This film is the story of Tony and Emma - a friendship which unfolds unexpectedly. A story of humour and emotion, of challenge and bravado, of music and dance - transcending the assumptions of a little understood condition, and triumphing over the odds to find joy, release and love.

A powerful, life-affirming British drama from Academy Award-nominated Director John Madden (Shakespeare in Love, The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel), Onwards and Sideways stars BAFTA Award-winner Rhys Ifans (Inheritance, House of the Dragon), Academy Award-nominee Laura Linney (Ozark, Love Actually), Monica Dolan (Mr Bates vs The Post Office, Sherwood), and Rory Kinnear (The Diplomat, The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power).

films.title: Other Mommy
films.certNote: strong horror, violence, gore, language
films.synopsis: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

films.title: Pan's Labyrinth (20th Anniversary)
films.certNote: Contains strong language and bloody violence
films.synopsis: In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious labyrinth, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.

films.title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
films.certNote: infrequent strong language, drug misuse
films.synopsis: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.

films.title: Prima Facie
films.certNote: Sexual violence theme with upsetting scene of sexual assault. Strong language and sex.
films.synopsis:
(Audience Advice: this film contains themes and scenes of sexual assault.)
A young, ambitious trial lawyer (Cynthia Erivo) brilliantly navigates the ruthless London court system where she is unmatched in her defence of the accused, including men charged with sexual assault. Just as her career is taking off, a life-altering event forces her to reckon with her belief in the judicial system that was once the core of her identity.

films.title: Primetime
films.certNote: child sexual abuse references, sex references, violence, nudity, language
films.synopsis: Inspired by true events in 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice in this candy-colored thriller from Lance Oppenheim.

films.title: Ramayana (Hindi)
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat
films.synopsis:
Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi.

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG is behind films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in cinemas in time for Diwali on November 5.

films.title: RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: Carmen
films.synopsis:
Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. She warns him not to fall in love with her, but his obsession knows no bounds. Damiano Michieletto’s searing production returns, casting scorching light on the lust, violence and destructive desire of Bizet’s ever-popular opera. 
An all-star cast brings this white-hot drama to life, with Ginger Costa-Jackson in the fiery title role, alongside Russell Thomas as the jealous and despairing Don José. Following his 2023 Royal Opera debut, Sesto Quatrini returns to conduct Bizet’s electrifying and sensual score.

films.title: RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: The Nutcracker
films.synopsis:
At a cosy Christmas party, young Clara meets the mysterious magician Drosselmeyer, who gives her a nutcracker doll. When the guests have departed and the house is asleep, Clara sneaks downstairs in search of the doll. Instead, she finds Drosselmeyer, who whisks her away on a journey into a whole world of enchantment: fantastical landscapes of flurried snow and glittering confection where toys come alive and the magic never stops. 
Peter Wright’s production of this festive family favourite sparkles to the wondrous swell of Tchaikovsky’s orchestral score, alongside the glow and grandeur of Julia Trevelyan Oman’s period designs.

films.title: Resident Evil
films.certNote: strong bloody violence, gore, horror, language
films.synopsis:
From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise.

In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

films.title: Screen Unseen (2 November)
films.synopsis:
Join us for Screen Unseen to watch highly-acclaimed, pre-release films from just £6*. But there’s a twist in the plot... you won’t know which film you’re seeing until the cinema lights go down. Can you handle the suspense? 

Screen Unseen is an over 15s event (unless otherwise stated). But the film you see could be rated anything from a U to 15. We won't tell you the run time but you’ll see the whole film, which usually lasts between 90 and 180 minutes. There will be a pre-feature reel beforehand,  however please be in your seats at the advertised time so you don't miss the start of the film!

films.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
films.certNote: very mild threat, scary scenes, rude humour, implied bad language
films.synopsis: Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control. With the Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure...

films.title: Stray Kids World Tour <RUN IT> LIVE VIEWING
films.synopsis:
For the first time, Stray Kids presents a special live broadcast of ‘Stray Kids World Tour <RUN IT>’ from Tokyo Dome in movie theaters around the globe.

True to the tour's title, <RUN IT> captures the group's drive to push into bigger worlds and bolder stages. The eight members (Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, HAN, Felix, Seungmin, and I.N) pour out unrelenting energy through explosive choreography and powerhouse vocals, elevating the live experience to its peak. Their stage begins with “Hall of Fame,” a track that expresses Stray Kids’ ambition to write their own history, tracing their musical growth from the very beginning to where they are now. The production is enriched further by dynamic stage setups, traditional Korean performance touches, and spectacular laser lighting, designed to bring the crowd — in the dome and at the cinema — to their feet, singing, dancing and celebrating together.

Captured live from Tokyo and broadcast into cinemas worldwide, this live viewing event lets STAY everywhere share in the scale, spectacle, and raw energy of Stray Kids' live performance — together, on the big screen.

films.title: Street Fighter
films.certNote: violence, injury detail, threat, sex references, infrequent strong language
films.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

films.title: Sunrise on the Reaping: Sunrise Event Screening
films.certNote: Violent scenes with graphic injury detail consistent with the franchise.
films.synopsis:
See The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping at first light.
 
For one morning only, Lionsgate, ODEON and Jenny Claffey present a special event screening celebrating the latest instalment in The Hunger Games franchise.
 
Be one of the first to experience the film on the big screen, with a special morning featuring photo opportunities, and an exclusive gift.
 
Tickets are limited, so secure your place and be there when the sun rises on a new chapter of The Hunger Games. 

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.title: Tabby McTat + The Room on the Broom
films.synopsis: In the bustling heart of London Tabby McTat, a singing cat, and his busker friend Fred, entertain passing crowds with their duo singing act.  The pair are “purrrfectly happy” performing on the city streets until one day they are unexpectedly separated.  Tabby McTat is alone and hungry in the city and searches for Fred for days.  He doesn’t find Fred, but he does find a new feline friend, Sock.  Sock’s owners warmly invite Tabby McTat into their home and before too long Sock and Tabby McTat have created three tiny kittens!  Meanwhile, Fred is looking for Tabby McTat and singing a solemn solo act. When the two are finally reunited, will their friendship stand up to all the changes in their lives?  Based on the book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler.

films.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
films.certNote: very mild threat, violence, rude humour, language
films.synopsis: Tad, his girlfriend Sara and their friends Momia, Jeff and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat, upsetting scenes
films.synopsis: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

series.name: The Hunger Games – New Trilogy Collection

films.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Yotsuba Arc
films.certNote: strong violence, injury detail
films.synopsis: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

films.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
films.synopsis: Mr Fish, a prickly recluse, and Pip, a hyperactive sea dragon, must embark on a daunting undersea quest in search of a mythical, wish-granting fish to save their homes. Based on the bestselling children's book series.

films.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
films.certNote: Strong violence, sex, nudity and language.
films.synopsis: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

films.title: THE SNOWMAN™ & THE SNOWMAN™ AND THE SNOWDOG
films.synopsis:
The Snowman™ film, adapted from Raymond Briggs’ classic picture book, is a family favourite. A timeless, magical tale of a boy whose snowman comes to life at midnight, it has captured the imagination of generations – and continues to enchant.

The animated sequel The Snowman™ and The Snowdog beautifully captures the magic and excitement of the original film as well as being a heart-warming story about love, loss and friendship. When a young boy, Billy, moves house, he discovers a secret box hidden under the floorboards – a snowman-making kit! Billy builds his snowman and, with a little spare snow, a Snowdog. At midnight, The Snowman and The Snowdog magically come to life. Join Billy on the most amazing adventure, as they fly over London to the North Pole and compete with an assortment of colourful characters in a very special race. On return, Billy must leave his new friends outside and return to bed – but first, a wonderful surprise awaits him…

films.title: Tony
films.certNote: strong language, drug misuse, brief sex
films.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

films.title: Verity
films.certNote: very strong language, strong sex, violence, bloody images
films.synopsis: Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality, manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

films.title: Whalefall
films.certNote: strong threat, injury detail
films.synopsis: A scuba diver in search of his deceased father's remains gets swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has only one hour to escape before his oxygen runs out. After giving up on life, the young man is surprised to find a reason to live in the most dangerous and unlikely of places.

films.title: Wicker
films.certNote: strong sex, language, sex references, injury detail
films.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.certNote: very strong language, strong violence, drug misuse
films.synopsis: Set in 1973, during the US’s attempt to overthrow the Chilean government, a hitman for the US government with connections to the JFK assassination suddenly realizes that his own people have put a hit on him to cover up the mess.

films.title: Wildwood
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat, language, upsetting scenes
films.synopsis:
After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee) launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness—
an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover the strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar®-nominated and BAFTA®-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes You Can See Everything.

films.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.synopsis: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.
